info.title: traydcraft API
info.description: Business platform API (CRM, products, pricing, sales, engineering, helpdesk, customer portal).

put.summary: Replaces the notes and lines of a draft BOM.

post.summary:
Makes a draft the active revision. The previous active revision becomes obsolete.
Refused if it would create a cycle anywhere in the product structure.

get.summary: Finds who is calling or writing: by phone number, e-mail address or name.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: A phone number in any format, e.g. the caller id.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: An e-mail address.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a name (first, last or customer).

get.summary:
What the customer sees before rating. Reading changes nothing, so mail scanners that open
links do not use up the token.

post.summary: Records the rating. The token works once and only until it expires.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches code, name, VAT number and city.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: Include contacts who left or are otherwise inactive.

delete.summary: Removes a rebate. Quotations keep the rebate they were priced with.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number, title and customer.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft | active | suspended | ended

post.summary: Starts a draft contract, or resumes a suspended one: planned jobs are generated again.
Ends a contract for good. Jobs already generated stay.

get.summary: The jobs generated for (or linked to) a contract, newest first.

post.summary: Pauses a contract: no jobs are generated until it is activated again.

get.summary: The visits due from today on, from the active templates, and whether their job exists.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Look ahead to this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: twelve months from today (at most 36).

get.summary: The installed units of a customer (delivered or installed, not scrapped) with their job history.
All jobs the user may see, for planning.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number, title, customer and city.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A status, or `active` for planned and in progress.

parameters.name: technician
parameters.description: `me`, `none` (unassigned) or a user id.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: Jobs generated for this maintenance contract.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Jobs scheduled from this moment on.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Jobs scheduled before this moment.

post.summary: Cancels a job (planners only).

Completing a job that is already completed with the same text changes nothing (safe to retry);
with other text it is a 409.
Links a unit of the job's customer to the job. Linking it twice changes nothing.
Records a part used on a job. No stock is deducted.

delete.summary: Removes a part. Removing one that is already gone changes nothing.

post.summary: Adds a photo: the request body is the image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 12 MB).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again returns the first upload.

post.summary: Takes a completed or cancelled job back into work (planners only).

get.summary: The service report of a job as PDF (a watermark marks it as draft until the job is completed).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl, fr, en, de or es. Default: the language of the contact, else of the customer.

post.summary:
E-mails the service report of a completed job to its contact (or the customer's main address)
and records when and to whom. Sending again is allowed. Refused (409) when there is no
address or the job is not completed.

get.summary: The signature image (PNG).

post.summary:
Stores the customer's signature: the request body is a PNG image. A job has one signature;
a new one replaces the old one until the service report is sent.

parameters.name: signer_name
parameters.description: Who signed, as they wrote it.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again changes nothing.

post.summary: Records that the customer declined to sign. Replaces an earlier signature.
Starts the job: the technician has arrived and begins. Starting twice changes nothing.
Ticks or unticks a task. Setting the state it already has changes nothing, so retries are safe.
Logs time and notes of work (or travel) on a job, for the logged-in technician.

get.summary:
The jobs assigned to me that still have to be done (plus those finished in the last week),
in the order of their appointment.

post.summary:
Logs a phone call. The caller is looked up by phone number; the call is added to the given
ticket, or a new ticket is opened for it.
Imports a raw e-mail (RFC 5322, e.g. a saved .eml file) as if it had arrived in the mailbox.

put.summary: Replaces the windows for the given priorities. Open tickets get new due times.

get.summary: All tags in use at this company, for filters and suggestions.

delete.summary: Deletes a category that has no entries and no sub-categories; otherwise deactivate it.

get.summary: Lists or searches entries. With `q` the best match comes first and each entry has a snippet.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (several words must all occur; "quoted phrases" and -excluded words work).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Includes the sub-categories of this category.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language to search and show; entries without it show English, then another language.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: internal | portal | public

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft | published | archived

put.summary:
Edits an entry. Editing a published entry saves a new version when the texts changed, and
changing the visibility of a published entry needs the right to publish.

post.summary: Retires an entry: hidden from readers, kept for staff.

Uploads an image for an entry: the request body is the file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most
12 MB). Use it in the text as `![description](image:<id>)`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The original file name.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again returns the first upload.

post.summary: Makes a draft or archived entry visible to its audience; saves the first version.
Takes a published entry back to draft.
Puts the texts of an earlier version back as a new version. History is never rewritten.

get.summary: All tags in use, for suggestions in filters and the editor.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number, title and customer name.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Only open (not won or lost) opportunities.

get.summary: Count, value and probability-weighted value per stage.

post.summary: Moves an opportunity through the pipeline. `won`/`lost` close it; any other stage reopens it.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches order number, quotation number, customer name and customer reference.

get.summary: The latest revision of an order.

put.summary:
Edits the draft revision: quantities, discounts, descriptions and notes. Prices and rebates
stay as agreed on the quotation; totals are recomputed here.

post.summary: Cancels the order. Possible until it is ready for shipping.
Confirms the order on the customer's behalf (e.g. after a phone call or an e-mail).

put.summary: Changes the priority of an order. The reason is required; the change is kept in the history.

get.summary: Customer requests to change the priority, newest first.

post.summary: Turns a customer request down without changing the priority.

Starts the next revision as a draft, copying the latest one. The sent revision is kept and
marked superseded: the customer can no longer confirm it.

get.summary: A specific revision of an order, e.g. an older one that was sent.
The order confirmation of one revision as PDF (a draft carries a watermark).

post.summary:
Sends the draft revision: it becomes `sent`, the order confirmation PDF is rendered in the
customer's language and queued as an e-mail for the worker. Refused (409) when there is no
address to send it to.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

get.summary: Browse or search the help articles.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Includes the sub-categories of this category.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

get.summary: One article. Counts one view. Internal, draft and archived entries are "not found".

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

put.summary: Says whether the article helped. One vote per contact and article; sending it again changes it.

get.summary: Up to three articles that fit what the contact types, for the "new ticket" form.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What the customer typed so far, e.g. the subject of a new ticket.

post.summary:
Always answers 202, whether or not the address belongs to a portal user, so the endpoint
cannot be used to find out who is a customer.

202.description: If the address may use the portal, a login link was sent.

get.summary: Orders of the customer: the latest revision that was sent or confirmed, never a draft.

post.summary: The customer confirms their order. Only the latest sent revision can be confirmed.
Asks staff to treat the order as more or less urgent. Staff decide.
Announces a repair that the customer is going to send in. Photos can be added afterwards.
Adds a photo to a repair: the request body is the image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 12 MB).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: sending the same id again returns the first upload.

delete.summary: Logs out: the session token stops working.

post.summary: Exchanges a login link for a session. A link works once.

Uploads a file to a ticket: the request body is the file (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, at most
12 MB). Send its id in `attachment_ids` with the next message.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The original file name.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again returns the first upload (safe retries).

get.summary: A file of a message the customer can see, as a download.

post.summary: Adds a message to a ticket. A closed ticket is reopened.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches code, name and texts.

get.summary: Placeholders that can be used in prepared answers, e.g. `{{quotation.number}}`.

post.summary:
Applies a bulk price change: one new dated price per product and zone.
Refused if any product already has a price starting on the same date.
Shows what a bulk price change would do, without changing anything.

Prices lines for a customer without saving. The app calls this while the user edits,
so every number on screen comes from the server's pricing engine.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches code and name.

get.summary: Explodes the active BOM of a product through all levels.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Quantity of the product to explode. Default 1.

post.summary: Starts a new draft revision, copied from `copy_from` or from the active BOM.

get.summary: Full price history of a product in the active company, newest first per zone.

post.summary: Adds a price for a zone from a date. Prices are never edited: a new entry supersedes older ones.
Registers a serialised unit. (Later also created automatically by production and goods receipt.)

get.summary: Categories that have public entries.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

get.summary: Public entries, or the best matches for the search words.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Includes the sub-categories of this category.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

get.summary:
One public entry. Counts one view. Internal, portal-only, draft and archived entries are
"not found".

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: nl | fr | en | de | es (default: the company's language)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number and customer name.

put.summary: Replaces customer, dates, notes and lines of a draft, repricing everything at its price date.

post.summary: Converts a sent or accepted quotation revision into a draft sales order (revision 1).

get.summary: Compares a quotation with today's price list and rebates, line by line. Changes nothing.

post.summary:
Creates the next revision as a new draft with the same number; the revised quotation becomes
`superseded`. `keep` copies the agreed prices and price list date unchanged; `current` reprices
at today's price list and rebates (indicative prices must then be confirmed again).

Freezes the quotation. From now on it can only be accepted, rejected or revised.
Refused while indicative prices are unconfirmed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number, customer, serial number, product and fault.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A status, or `open` for everything not yet shipped or cancelled.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department id, or `none` for repairs not routed yet.

parameters.name: assigned
parameters.description: `me` for repairs assigned to me, or a user id.

post.summary: Registers a repair. Give a `ticket_id` to create it from the ticket where it was announced.

put.summary: Changes the descriptive fields of a repair (not its status or department).

post.summary: An internal note on the repair (diagnosis, parts used, test results). The customer never sees it.
Adds a photo: the request body is the image itself (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 12 MB).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The original file name.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again returns the first upload (safe retries).

get.summary: The image itself.

post.summary: Routes a repair to a department (or on to another one). It waits there as `routed`.
Moves a repair along its workflow (everything except routing, see `/route`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches serial number and product code.

post.summary:
Records that a serialised component was built into this unit. The component's product must be
part of the unit's BOM revision, and no more units may be attached than the BOM quantity.
Removes a component (e.g. replaced during a repair). The link is kept in the history.

put.summary: Sets the warranty of a unit: until when, and a note (terms, contract).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches number, subject, contact and customer.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A status, or `active` for everything not closed.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: `me` for my tickets, `none` for unassigned, or a user id.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Tickets in this team.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Tickets that are mine: I own them, or nobody owns them and they are in one of my teams.

parameters.name: unassigned
parameters.description: Tickets with neither an owner nor a team.

parameters.name: sla
parameters.description: `breached` or `at_risk` (under 25 % of a window left).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tickets with this tag.

post.summary:
Production asks a question about an order. It becomes an internal ticket for the salesperson,
in the customer's language, so they can ask the customer and report back in a note.

put.summary: Assigns a ticket to a team and/or an owner.

post.summary:
Uploads a file to the ticket: the request body is the file itself (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF,
at most 12 MB). Attach it to a note or reply by passing its id in `attachment_ids`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The original file name.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A client-chosen id: uploading the same id again returns the first upload (safe retries).

get.summary: The file itself, as a download.

post.summary:
The customer confirmed the linked quotation: convert it into a sales order.
If the customer asked for changes, revise the quotation first and link the new revision.

get.summary: An entry in the ticket's language as plain text and a link, to put in a reply. Nothing is sent.

Published entries that fit a ticket: the words of the subject and the latest customer
message, searched in the ticket's language. Internal entries are included; entries linked
to the ticket's category rank higher.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many entries (default 5, at most 10).

post.summary: Turns the ticket into a sales lead: creates an opportunity for its customer and links it.

Merges this ticket into another ticket of the same customer. Articles (with their
attachments), tags and time entries move to the target; this ticket is closed with a note
and points at the target. A merge cannot be undone. Returns the target.
Adds an internal note: never sent to the customer.
Fills in a prepared answer for a ticket, in the ticket's language. Nothing is sent.

get.summary: The repairs registered for a ticket (the ticket may announce several).

post.summary: Queues an e-mail to the customer. The worker sends it; delivery status shows on the article.

delete.summary: Removes an entry: one's own, or any with the helpdesk admin permission.

customer_reference.description: The customer's own reference (RMA or purchase order).

product_description.description: The product in the customer's words, e.g. "Pump 5 kW, blue".

attachments.description: Files sent or received with the message.

contact_id.description: The person this message or call is from or to, when known.

delivery.description: For outgoing e-mail: queued | sent | failed

kind.description: email_in | email_out | note | call_in | call_out | portal_in

phone_number.description: For calls: the number as typed.

AssignmentInput.description: Where a ticket goes: both fields replace the current values (empty clears).

component_has_bom.description: True if the component has an active BOM itself (a subassembly).

product_ids.description: Limit to these products (combined with the family filter, if any).

rounding.description: Round new prices to a multiple of this step, e.g. 0.01, 0.05 or 1. Default 0.01.

valid_from.description: First day of the new prices; today or later.

zone_ids.description: Zones to change; empty = all zones of the active company.

conflict.description: A price starting on exactly `valid_from` already exists.

current_price.description: Price valid on `valid_from` before the change.

applied.description: Number of prices created (0 for a preview).

without_price.description: Product/zone combinations without any price to start from (left unchanged).

CallInput.description: A phone call, logged on a ticket (existing or new).

contact_id.description: Who it was. Defaults to the contact with this phone number, if there is exactly one.

customer_id.description: New ticket only, for a caller who is not a known contact yet.

direction.description: in (the customer called us) | out (we called the customer)

phone_number.description:
The number that called or was called, in any format. Used to find the person when
`contact_id` is not given.

subject.description: New ticket only; defaults to the first line of the summary.

ticket_id.description: Add to this ticket; without it a new ticket is opened.

entry_count.description: Entries in this category (not counting its sub-categories).

parent_id.description: Only one level of nesting: the parent has no parent itself.

names.description: At least one language; the others fall back to English.

Company.description: A legal entity (own VAT number, own numbering, own stock and books).

CompanyUser.description: A colleague in the active company (for assigning tickets, owners, ...).

notes.description: What was done, and anything left open.

ComponentHistory.description: A component link of this unit, including removed ones.

revision.description: The revision being confirmed; refused when it is not the latest. Defaults to the latest.
The revision the customer is looking at; refused when it is no longer the latest.

customer_language.description: The language of the customer (company level).

effective_language.description: The language to write to this person in: their own, else the customer's.

greeting.description: Ready-made salutation in the effective language and address form.

language.description: The person's own language; null means the same as the customer.

roles.description: sales_contact | technical | purchasing | invoicing | management | quality | other

emails.description: The first one is the primary address.

language.description: nl | fr | en | de | es; null = same as the customer.

title.description: mr | ms | none — used in the salutation.

normalized.description: Digits with country code, used for lookup.

equipment_ids.description: Units of the customer covered by the contract.

site_name.description: The site covered. Left empty, the customer's address is used.

visit_templates.description: The complete set of visit templates; templates left out are removed.

open_jobs.description: Generated jobs that are not finished.

customer_reference.description: The customer's purchase order number or reference.
The customer's purchase order number or reference.

language.description: The language of the ticket, for the page the customer lands on.

jobs.description: The jobs this unit was worked on in, newest first (only those the user may see).

CustomerMatch.description: A customer found through its main phone number or e-mail address, when no contact matches.

reason.description: Why the customer did not sign.

open_repairs.description: Repairs currently in this department (routed, in progress or waiting).

member_user_ids.description: The colleagues who work in this department and may work on its repairs.

child_status.description: What happens to the removed component: in_stock (default) or scrapped.

ticket_categories.description: Ticket categories this entry helps with (shown first in suggestions).

version.description: Number of the latest saved version (0 when never published).

texts.description: At least one language with a title; others fall back to English.

language.description: The language of the title and snippet shown.

score.description: Relevance of a search match (higher is better).

snippet.description: Plain text; matched words are wrapped in U+E000 / U+E001 when searching.

body.description: Simple Markdown: headings, bold, italics, lists, links and images (`image:<file id>`).

restored_from.description: Set when this version was made by restoring an earlier one.

ErrorBody.description: Error body returned by every endpoint.

error.description: Machine-readable code: unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, validation, conflict, internal.

requirements.description: Totals of leaf components (to buy, or to make without a BOM).

ExplosionNode.description: One row of an exploded structure, depth-first. `parent_index` points into the same list.

required_quantity.description: Needed for the requested quantity, scrap included (rounded to 4 decimals).

csat_enabled.description: Send a satisfaction survey when a ticket is closed.

default_team_id.description: New tickets from e-mail, the portal and the phone start in this team.

contact_id.description: The person to meet on site.

contract_id.description: The maintenance contract this job was generated for.

due_date.description: The day a contract visit is due.

instructions.description: What has to be done there.

report_sent_at.description: When the service report was last e-mailed to the customer.

contact_phones.description: Phone numbers of the person to meet, to call when arriving.

equipment.description: Equipment (installed units of the customer) worked on.

parts.description: Parts used (record only; stock is not deducted).

oneOf.description: The customer's signature, or that they declined to sign.

work_minutes.description: Total minutes of work and of travel logged so far.

site_name.description: Where to go. Left empty, the customer's address is used.

tasks.description: The checklist; only used when creating (change it with the task endpoints).

id.description: The id of the file; fetch it from `/field/jobs/{id}/photos/{photo_id}`.

has_image.description: A signature image is stored: fetch it from `/field/jobs/{id}/signature`.

company_id.description: The company whose portal this is.

customers.description:
Customers whose main phone number or e-mail address matches. Useful when the caller is
not (yet) a known contact, or calls from the customer's switchboard.

Me.description: The authenticated user, the active company and all companies they can switch to.

target_id.description: The ticket that stays and receives everything.

attachment_ids.description: Files uploaded to the ticket (`POST /portal/tickets/{id}/attachments`) to send along.

copy_from.description: Copies the lines of this BOM (any revision of the same product). Default: the active BOM, if any.

announced.description: True when the customer announced it but it has not arrived yet.

customer_id.description: Optional when `ticket_id` is given and the ticket has a customer.

fault_description.description: What is wrong. Defaults to the subject of the ticket.

ticket_id.description: The ticket where the customer announced the repair.

NewTicketInput.description: A ticket opened by hand (phone call, visit, internal question).

contact_id.description:
The person; fills in customer, name, e-mail address and language (their own, else the
customer's) unless given.

language.description: Defaults to the contact's language, else the customer's, else the company's.

attachment_ids.description: Files uploaded to the ticket (`POST /tickets/{id}/attachments`) to attach to this note.

status.description: New ticket status; unchanged when omitted.

probability.description: Defaults to the stage's default probability.

Order.description: One revision of an order (the latest unless asked otherwise) with its lines.

confirmed_by.description: A staff user id (`confirmed_via` = staff) or a contact id (portal).

revision.description: The revision these lines and totals belong to.

OrderEditInput.description:
Changes to a draft revision. Lines that are left out are removed; prices and rebates stay as
agreed on the quotation, the totals are recomputed by the server.

description.description: Replaces the description; empty keeps the current one.

position.description: The position of the line in the current draft revision.

sent_to.description: The address the order confirmation was e-mailed to.

status.description: draft | sent | confirmed | in_planning | planned | in_production | ready_for_shipping | cancelled

billable.description: Is the part charged to the customer? Default yes.

description.description: Required for free text; defaults to the product's name.

id.description: Chosen by the client: sending the same id again changes nothing (offline retries).

product_id.description: A product from the catalogue; leave empty for free text.

serial_unit_id.description: The unit (serial number) the part went into.

unit.description: Defaults to the product's unit, or `pcs`.

number.description: Any common format. Without a country code the customer's country is assumed.

id.description: The id of the file; fetch it from `/repairs/{id}/photos/{photo_id}`.

attachments.description: Files sent with the message. Files on internal notes are never shown.

can_confirm.description: True while this revision is the latest and waits for the customer's confirmation.

revision.description: The revision shown here: the latest that was sent or confirmed, never a draft.

PortalProfile.description: Who is logged in, as the portal shows it.

effective_language.description: The language the portal and our e-mails use for this person.

language.description: The person's own language; null means the same as the company.

contact_name.description: Who registered it (colleagues' repairs are visible with the `customer` scope).

status.description: announced | in_repair | waiting_customer | ready | shipped | cancelled

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every portal request.

contact_name.description: Who raised it (colleagues' tickets are visible with the `customer` scope).

status.description: open | pending_customer (we wait for the customer) | closed

code.description: Short code to find the answer quickly, e.g. `order-confirmed`.

texts.description: At least one language; missing languages fall back to English, then any other.

PricingPreview.description: Result of pricing lines without saving anything.

unconfirmed_lines.description: Indicative prices still to confirm; the quotation cannot be sent while this is not 0.

price_date.description: Price list date; defaults to the quote date.

request_id.description: The customer request this change answers; it is marked applied.

pricing_type.description:
list (rebates apply) | net (fixed net price, never discounted) |
indicative (price must be confirmed on each quotation)

tracking.description: none | serial — serial-tracked products get an individual serial number per unit.

ProductionQuestionInput.description: A question from production about an order, routed to the salesperson who sold it.

ProfileInput.description: What a customer may change about themselves: how they want to be addressed.

language.description: nl | fr | en | de | es; null = same as the company.

Quotation.description: A quotation with its lines (flat JSON: header fields, `lines`, `vat_groups`).

opportunity_id.description: Links the quotation to an open opportunity of the same customer.

price_date.description:
Date of the price list used. Defaults to the quote date (on update: unchanged).
A date before the quote date needs the prices.backdate permission.

list_unit_price.description: Zone list price, or the confirmed price of an indicative product.

price_confirmed.description: False for an indicative price that still has to be confirmed.

rebate_percent.description: Customer rebate applied to this line.

rebate_source.description: Where the rebate comes from: product | family | general | net

description.description: Overrides the product name on the document.

unit_price.description:
Confirmed unit price (before rebates) for an indicative product. Indicative lines must be
confirmed before the quotation can be sent. Not allowed for other products.

entry_count.description: Entries the reader can open in this category, sub-categories included.

body.description: Simple Markdown. Images are written as `image:<id>` and listed in `images`.

fallback.description: True when the text is not in the language asked for.

language.description: The language of the text shown.

my_vote.description: The vote of the logged-in contact (portal only): true = helpful.

ReaderSummary.description: Public summary of a hit: nothing about counters or status.

snippet.description: Plain text; matched words are wrapped in U+E000 / U+E001 when searching.

fallback.description: True when no text exists in the ticket's language and another language was used.
True when the ticket's language has no text and another was used.

link.description:
Address of the entry in the customer portal; absent for internal entries or when the
company has no portal address.

text.description: The text without Markdown, ready for an e-mail.

product_description.description: The product as the customer describes it.

status.description: announced | received | routed | in_progress | waiting_customer | waiting_parts | completed | shipped | cancelled

ticket_id.description: The ticket where the repair was announced or discussed.

attachment_ids.description: Files uploaded to the ticket (`POST /tickets/{id}/attachments`) to send with the e-mail.

status.description: New ticket status; defaults to pending_customer.

subject.description: Defaults to "Re: <ticket subject>". The ticket tag is always added.

to.description: Defaults to the ticket's contact e-mail.

RepricingComparison.description: What would change if a quotation were repriced at today's prices.

RepricingLine.description: One line of a quotation compared with today's prices.

needs_confirmation.description: The new price is an indicative suggestion that must be confirmed.

assigned_user_id.description: A member of the department who should do it; leave empty to let the department pick it up.

SerialComponent.description: A serialised component in the current as-built tree, depth-first.

bom_id.description: BOM revision the unit was built to. Default: the product's active BOM, if any.

customer_id.description: Required for delivered and installed, unless the unit already has a customer.

status.description: in_stock | delivered | installed | scrapped (built_in is set by attaching to another unit)

parent_id.description: The unit this one is currently built into.

warranty_status.description: in_warranty | expired | unknown (no end date recorded)

warranty_until.description: The end of the warranty, if known.

token.description: The token from the login link.

probability.description: Defaults to the stage's default probability.

TargetState.description: What one target (first response or resolution) looks like at `now`.

at_risk.description: Not breached, not met yet and less than 25 % of the window is left.

breached.description: The due time passed before it was met (or, if still open, it has passed).

due_at.description: When it is due; empty when the ticket has no service level (internal tickets).

met_at.description: When it was met (first response sent, ticket closed).

minutes_remaining.description: Whole minutes left (negative when overdue). Empty once the target is met.

client_id.description:
Chosen by the client: sending the same id again returns the first task instead of adding a
second one (offline retries). The same id with another description is a 409.

members.description: The complete member list: members not listed are removed.

anchor_date.description: The first due date; defaults to the start of the contract.

id.description: Give the id of an existing template to change it; without one a new template is made.

category.description: question | lead | quote_change | order_confirmation | production_question | service | complaint | other

contact_id.description: The person at the customer this ticket is about (see the contacts of the customer).

csat_rating.description: The customer's latest satisfaction rating: good | bad.

language.description: nl | fr | en | de | es — the language to answer in.

merged_into_id.description: Set when this ticket was merged into another one (it is closed).

sla.description: Due times, breach flags and minutes remaining.

suggested_category.description: What the system guessed from the last incoming e-mail.

team_id.description: The queue the ticket waits in (the owner is the person working on it).

TicketInput.description: Full update of the ticket's fields and links.

TicketSla.description: The SLA of a ticket as the API shows it.

paused.description: The clock is stopped: the ticket waits for the customer.

state.description: none (no service level) | on_time | at_risk | breached

generate_on.description: The day the job is (or was) generated.

anchor_date.description: The first due date (and the day of the month for `months_list`).

lead_days.description: The job is generated this many days before the due date.

next_due.description: The next due date from today on, within the contract's term.

warranty_until.description: The last day of the warranty; empty when unknown.

id.description: Chosen by the client: sending the same id again changes nothing (offline retries).
